series_level_findings: FOUNDING YEAR: the catalogue's 1979 start is supported. The CSUN Daily Sundial of 9 Nov 1979 calls the event 'the 1979 ACM Southern California Regional Computer Programming Contest' hosted by the CSUN Computer Science Association and the San Fernando (Valley) ACM chapter in the CSUN Computer Center on Sunday 11 Nov 1979, with invitations to 'all college-level schools in the Southern California region of the National ACM'; six schools took part (UCLA, USC, El Camino College, Cal Poly Pomona, UNLV, CSUN). The 14 Nov 1980 Sundial says 1980 was 'the second year CSUN has entered the competition and the second year it has hosted it', that Pomona won 'last year', and quotes Marc Furon as vice president of the CSUN ACM student chapter - consistent with the coordinator's Usenet finding that Furon was scorekeeper for 1979/80 (he later became RCD at Unocal). No 1978 contest mention exists in the Sundial's full text. HOSTS KNOWN: 1979 CSUN, 1980 CSUN, 1994 UC Irvine (inferred), 1995 UC San Diego, 1996 CSUN (37 teams), 1997 CSUN. WINNERS KNOWN: 1979 Cal Poly Pomona; 1982 UCLA (2nd at 1983 finals); 1985, 1986, 1987, 1988 Caltech ('fourth straight year', Caltech News Feb 1989; Caltech won the 1986 and 1988 finals; UCLA 3rd in 1988 and won the 1989 finals); 1994 Caltech (Furon); 1996-1998 HMC. FORMAT 1979-80: teams of four, six hours, four problems, FORTRAN 77, punch cards; 1988: six problems, six hours, teams of four. WORKING PROGRAMMATIC SOURCES (reusable for other groups): (1) CSUN Daily Sundial on CONTENTdm - search API https://digital-collections.csun.edu/digital/api/search/collection/Sundial/searchterm/<phrase>/field/all/mode/exact/conn/and/maxRecords/200 and per-page OCR via https://digital-collections.csun.edu/digital/bl/dmwebservices/index.php?q=dmGetItemInfo/Sundial/<pageptr>/json (field 'fullte'); compound-object page pointers via dmGetCompoundObjectInfo. (2) UCLA Daily Bruin microfilm on archive.org (items ucladailybruinNNlosa, N=01..199): full-text phrase search via https://<d2 server>/fulltext/inside.php?item_id=<id>&doc=<id>&path=<dir>&q=%22phrase%22 (server/dir from https://archive.org/metadata/<id>); reel-to-date calibration: reel 68 = Oct 1975, 83 = Sep 1980, 91 = Jan-Mar 1983, 120 = Feb-Mar 1989, 131 = Sep-Oct 1990 (about 5-7 reels per year); note the _djvu.txt file does NOT contain the same OCR as the FTS index. (3) Caltech campus publications (California Tech weekly, Caltech News alumni bimonthly) at https://campuspubs.library.caltech.edu/view/year/<year>.html - static EPrints copy, every issue is a text-layer PDF at /<id>/01/<file>.pdf, no server-side search; all Oct-Dec and Jan-Apr California Tech issues 1980-1995 and all Caltech News 1979-1995 were downloaded and grepped - the student paper never covered the contest, the alumni magazine did twice (June 1986, Feb 1989). (4) Engineering & Science (calteches.library.caltech.edu, same structure) 1980-1994: nothing. PEOPLE TO ASK: David Smallberg (UCLA, coach/competitor 1982-1997+), Dave Gillespie (Caltech 1986/88, coach 1988), Marc Furon, Russ Abbott (CSUN CS, 1980).
